messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Mazalov,

Your executive-search leadership across clean power generation, solar, BESS and wind aligns with my international profile at the intersection of energy transition, ESG and institutional affairs. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where clean-energy growth requires regulatory coordination, stakeholder trust and disciplined execution. I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
